two_pass.selection_rule: On val only, over W2 in {256, 128, 64}, N in {W2, min(2*W2, 510), 510} and t2 in T2_GRID: keep settings whose paired 95% upper bound of FPR(two-pass) - FPR(510) is <= +2 points and that add no benign_hard false positive over DeBERTa-510; among them maximize val recall, then minimize pass-2 model tokens, then prefer the larger t2.
